selection_algorithm: For every eligible question_id, compute sha256(sample_seed + ':' + question_id).hexdigest(); sort ascending by (hash, question_id); select the first 30. No shuffle, replacement, resampling, outcome-based exclusion, or parameter change is permitted after this artifact is frozen.

eligibility_rule.formal_relevant_document_boundary: At least one chunk from the sole formal relevant document must appear somewhere in the frozen historical E0 Dense Top100; Dense first5 membership is not required.

exclusion_contract.hash_serialization: UTF-8 bytes of the sorted unique question IDs joined by one actual LF separator byte (0x0A), with no leading or trailing separator
exclusion_contract.policy: Apply the union before eligibility hashing and sampling.

g2_contract.document_admission_order: one shared global rerank order over the same frozen historical E0 Dense Top100
g2_contract.one_variable_statement: Only document-admission order differs from G1; all downstream document expansion, merged rerank, Top16 evidence selection, context cap, model, and instruction remain fixed.

rerank_contract.instruction: Rank the candidate passages by relevance to resolving the technical support query.

provider_call_budget.provider_failure_policy: Any provider failure stops the run; no retry, candidate truncation, case replacement, or model change is allowed.

go_no_go_rule.GO_TO_NEXT_STAGE: yes only if every gate is satisfied
gates: all 30 cases execute under the frozen provider/capacity contract
catastrophic regression count is 0, where catastrophic regression is G1=COMPLETE && G2=INSUFFICIENT
go_no_go_rule.all_contexts_tie: NO_GO because the strict G2_wins > G2_losses gate is not met.
go_no_go_rule.go_scope: A GO authorizes only a next design/evaluation stage; it does not establish production accuracy, latency improvement, statistical significance, or serving-path promotion.
